source_text: Aries in vepre cornibus haerens — Christus in ligno. Pro Isaac substituitur.
pass_a_gloss: Ram in thorn-bush by-horns sticking — Christ on wood. For Isaac is-substituted.
pass_b_english: [[A ram caught in the thicket by its horns >> Bible:Genesis 22:13]] — Christ on the wood. Substituted for Isaac.
